title: feat(objectql, core, metadata)!: tool names held per namespace, and the metadata service keeps each package's tool in its own (package, name) slot (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXRWeP56mz1feRhavJjB9TE)_

domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAsPKFDh4mQVjKENf

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：工具（tool）的同名规则从「整个部署只能有一个包持有」放宽为「每个命名空间一个」，和 agent、skill、action、邮件模板、flow、picklist 一族一样；元数据服务同时把 tool 按（包，名字）分槽存，两个包的同名工具都保留。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 第 14 张 B 卡。开源仓里包的 tool 记录只有 `/meta/tool/NAME` 一个按名读取处，它早已按包解析；main 要求放宽的类型同时进按包存储的集合，所以两处一起改。合了最新 main（#32497：按名读取只算正在服务的包）后逐条重推了持有者读取。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING，只动进程内元数据服务的五个答案（两包同名的 tool 无包名读取、删除、历史/比较/回滚由「最后一个」改为 409 点名两包等），第一方调用方 0；HTTP 与 MCP 门不变。同命名空间共有者、无命名空间的包、base/system/sys、内置名照旧被拒，原句不变。回滚就是把 `tool` 从两个集合删掉。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`（集合加 `tool`）、`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`（存储集合加 `tool`）、`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`（含新加的停用共持有者 pin）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts -t tool`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。云端条件已由专题裁定 6838039881 认定满足（(b)，云端从不读包内 tool 记录），见下方 Draft condition。

Fixes #31985
Supersedes #32558

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widened: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for a tool, a second package holder from another declared namespace. Narrowed: `tool` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so five in-process answers of the metadata service for a tool move from served to refused or empty (rows 5–9 below); first-party callers in this repo 0.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: #32916 (owed: `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` and the spec jsdoc still call a tool name globally unique) — otherwise `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no tool rename on a cross-namespace clash, no in-process `get('tool', …)`, no tool history read and no `/layers?package=` read of a tool (`git grep -n -i "tool" -- skills content/docs` read for those four shapes at this head: 0).

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers in this repo **0**: no production source calls `get`, `getDiagnosed`, `unregister`, `getHistory`, `diff` or `rollback` with the type `tool`; first-party tool records in `examples/`: 0; on a booted stack no HTTP or MCP door moves from served to refused: the bare `/meta/tool/NAME` reads through `resolveItem`, which already resolved a tool by `(package, name)` (child E8), and MCP reads no `tool` record (two by-order paths, not moved here, are carried: Acceptance notes). The cloud's calls on the metadata service for type `tool` are listed in the cloud reading 6837767385 and carried to the cloud separately (Carried to repo:cloud).

> **Draft condition (epic read 6760270915): met, limb (b).** The condition was that this PR leaves draft only on (a) a merged cloud change resolving a package's tool by `(package, name)`, or (b) a showing that no deployment can reach a pick between two holders. **This PR relies on (b)**, per the epic ruling 6838039881 (2026-11-12T22:46Z) on the cloud reading 6837767385 (cloud `main@9b50c62e`, source read, tests excluded, positive control on `skill`): no cloud reader reads a package `tool` record at all. The cloud's four touches of type `tool` are a fixed-name `exists` probe and AI Studio mirroring its built-in tools INTO metadata and retracting them; a skill's `tools[]` resolves by name against the live `ToolRegistry` of code-defined definitions. A test here cannot pin cloud code, so, as the ruling requires, `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` names cloud `9b50c62e` and the reading, and keeps the rule for the first cloud reader: resolve by the referrer's own `(package, name)`, refuse two holders `409` naming every candidate, never the first registered. (a) is not relied on.
>
> **Landing order.** `main` was merged once before this PR (merge, never rebase); it is merged again only on a GitHub conflict (#32577 also edits both sets), a main-caused red, a queue kick, or K ≥ 15 before queuing. The old order (#31699 PR 3 first) is void (epic seat dispatch). The seat runs the contract review, then the epic seat's red-line read, before landing.

## What changes

This PR takes over #32558 (branch `claude/project-thread-x8suof`, head `c86bfb66`, itself the takeover of #32081), keeping its five commits, and merges `origin/main` `f770d664` into them (`fbce0e517`, a merge, never a rebase). This thread cannot push `x8suof`, so it is a new draft; #32558 is closed (seat comment 6838242219).

Since #32558's base (`21667430`) main narrowed `flow` (#32507) and the picklist family (#32513), and changed what a by-name read counts as a holder (#32497). The merge resolves five conflicts:

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: `tool` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` after `skill`, beside the families narrowed since; the doc names each.
- `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`: `tool` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` after the picklist family; doc names it.
- `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`: doc only, both paragraphs kept (the picklist family's, then `tool`'s), and `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES`' census (0).
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: the #32151 in-memory pins' list is main's plus `tool`.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: main moved the fixture's one sealed clash from the picklist to the tool; with `tool` narrowed too, it moves to a connector `m31693_link` both namespaces declare (a type still held once per deployment), so the sealed-clash section keeps a positive pin.

Also: `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` (`_note` only, claim amendment 6760298444), `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`, and `.changeset/31985-tool-names-per-namespace.md` (`@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata` minor), brought to main's sets.

## Holder reads, re-derived after #32497

#32497 made `SchemaRegistry.packageScopedHoldersOf` answer the SERVED holders (a disabled package holds no name) unless a caller passes `includeDisabledPackages: true`. Every read this change reaches for a tool, and which set it reads:

| Reader | Reads | Why | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Install door, item seam, cold-boot seal (`bareNameHoldersOtherThan` → `bareNamePackageHolders`) | every installed holder | a disable is reversible: the door never admits what the re-enable would refuse | ai-family "[#31985] one of two namespaces' tool holders disabled": a package with no namespace is refused naming the disabled holder too |
| Bare `/meta/tool/NAME`, `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem('tool', NAME)` (`readPackageScopedItem`) | served | the bare read judges the holders the list shows | same pin: serves the enabled holder; re-enabled, `409` naming both, never a disabled third |
| `/meta/tool/NAME/published` | served, then the store's slot of that package | #32497 passes the served holder's package to `MetadataManager.getPublished` | `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` pins in `@objectstack/metadata` (run for `tool`) |
| `MetadataManager.get` / `unregister` / history (the slotted store) | the store's own slots | the store has no enablement reading; unchanged by #32497 | metadata #32151 / #32198 / #32246 / #32351 pins, iterating the set |
| `os migrate stored-references` (`stored-package-references.ts`) | every holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`) | a durable report | `stored-references.integration.test.ts` |

No new holder read is added outside tests.

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

FROM is `origin/main` `f770d664`; TO is this head.

| # | Surface | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `installPackage` / `registerItem` of a package whose namespace differs from the tool name's holder's | refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming both holders | installs | widening | ai-family "the narrowing" matrix (`tool`); dogfood third-namespace install |
| 2 | cold boot of two namespaces' holders of one tool name | boots with one bare-name warning naming the tool | boots, no warning | widening | ai-family cold-boot pin; dogfood "no bare-name warning" |
| 3 | `os migrate stored-references` sealed clashes | listed two namespaces' tool holders | not listed | widening | `stored-references.integration.test.ts` (the connector stays listed) |
| 4 | bare read of a tool name two namespaces hold, one disabled | (unreachable: the second holder was refused) | the enabled holder's; re-enabled, `409` naming both | widening | ai-family "[#31985] one of two namespaces' tool holders disabled", both orders |
| 5 | `MetadataManager.get('tool', NAME)` / `getDiagnosed`, no package, two holders | item registered (or saved) last | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`) naming both | narrowing | metadata #32151 / #32246 SLOTTED pins (`tool`), dogfood artifact-door block |
| 6 | `get('tool', NAME, PKG)` / `getDiagnosed`, PKG holds no slot, another does | the stored item | `undefined`; no loader asked | narrowing | metadata #32151 pin, dogfood "answers nothing" |
| 7 | `unregister('tool', NAME)` no package, two holders; rollback of a name with two slots' rows | resolves (deleted nothing / overwrote the first row) | `409` naming every holder, before any delete, event or write | narrowing | metadata #32198 / #32246 SLOTTED pins |
| 8 | `DatabaseLoader.delete` by name, no package, two holders | deleted the first row | refused | narrowing | metadata #32246 SLOTTED pins |
| 9 | `getHistory` / `diff` / `rollback` of a tool name two packages saved, no package; a rollback to a removed package's version | every version of the one row; the version written into the remaining holder's row | `409` naming both; the rollback refused | narrowing | `metadata-history.test.ts` (iterates `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`) |
| 10 | `DatabaseLoader.save` of a tool | one row per name, `package_id` empty | one row per `(package, name)`, `package_id` filled; history rows record the package | storage | metadata #32246 SLOTTED pins; `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` pins (`tool`) |
| 11 | `list('tool')`, `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed('tool')`, `GET /meta/tool` with two holders | the survivor | each package's item | widening | metadata SLOTTED `list` pins; `metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts` (`tool` in `UNBUNDLED`) |
| 12 | `GET /meta/tool/NAME/layers?package=PKG`, two holders, artifact boot | PKG's own (the layered read already judged the code layer at the exact address) | unchanged | none (pinned) | dogfood artifact-door `/layers?package=` (`tool`); stays green with `tool` taken back out of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (measured) |
| 13 | bare `/meta/tool/NAME` on a registry whose `readsByPackage('tool')` is `false` | `getItem`'s first match | `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | narrowing (no in-repo composition: `SchemaRegistry` answers `true`) | `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (b) `it.each` over the narrowed set |
| 14 | replica convergence on a cluster signal for a tool | the first row the store returns by name | a signal naming a package: that package's row; an unstamped signal of a name bound to two or more packages: a logged stop, ledger entry kept (#32451) | narrowing | `metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts` slotted removal pins (iterate the set, `tool` included); the protocol's convergence pins (`protocol.cluster-mutation-fanout.test.ts`) measure `action`, the rule is the set's |
| 15 | boot priming pass, a package-less stored tool row of a name two packages hold | stamped with the host's package | left unbound, no holder's own (ADR-0150 D4) | narrowing | `database-loader.test.ts` `[#32521]` priming pins (iterate the unbundled slotted set, `tool` included) |

Still refused, each with today's envelope and sentence: a co-owner of the holder's namespace (for a tool that is the namespace co-owner rule's `NamespaceNameConflictError`, child N, which judges a tool ahead of this rule at every install, boot included), a package with no namespace beside any holder (a disabled one included), two packages of one shareable namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), and a built-in name.

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** No reader in this repo resolves a `skill.tools[]` entry or an agent's tool from a `tool` record (reading (b)); the one by-name reader, `/meta/tool/NAME`, keeps ADR-0150 D3's order (own item, else the one holder in the declared closure; never the environment's for a package caller, never outside the closure), pinned by child E8's `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (`tool` in `E8_TYPES`). Nothing here widens what a package caller reaches.
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** Two served holders of a tool name answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both at the bare read (ai-family `[#31985]` pins, dogfood) and at the metadata service (rows 5, 7, 8, 9); none of those answers by registration order. Two paths still do, both carried and both already reached by every narrowed type (Acceptance notes): the boot hydration of a package-less stored row (#32692), and the protocol's in-process layered read (`getMetaItemLayered`) of a bare name where the metadata service gives it no copy. Both HTTP transports refuse the bare `/layers` read `409` before serving it. A disabled holder is no holder for a read and still a holder for the door (row 4). The cloud half of this red line is the draft condition above: the cloud reads no package tool record (6837767385, ruled 6838039881).
3. **Independently releasable.** Clause-② line and arm above and in the changeset, every moved answer in the table above and in the changeset, `Metadata-protocol: added`, the ADR-0087 marker below, and pins that go red under ablation with CONTROLs green (Tests).

## ADR-0087

The changeset carries `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no key of any schema is added, removed, renamed or re-shaped and no stored row changes shape; what moves is which second package an install admits for a tool name, and which stored tool item an in-process read of the metadata service answers. `Metadata-protocol: added` (a second package's tool of a name another namespace holds is now accepted; nothing an author writes is refused or tightened), so no semantic entry is owed, as for #32577's webhook family.

## Readings (a)–(d), re-measured on this head

- **(a) Face (D6).** No surface in this repo shows a package `tool` record to a model or an MCP client: the MCP bridge (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`) lists the AI service's live registry, whose `AIToolDefinition` carries no package and is never minted from a `tool` record. Since #32558's base: 269 non-test source files changed between `21667430` and `f770d664`; 0 of them add a line naming a tool record, `tools[]`, `getTool`/`resolveTool` or a tool registry.
- **(b) Caller references (D3).** `agent.tools` was removed in spec 17; a skill's `tools[]` is resolved only by the cloud runtime. The static R7 lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`) is per stack. `findReferencesToMeta({ type: 'tool' })` (the "Used by" panel) matches by bare name across every skill, so with two holders it lists both packages' referring skills: over-inclusive, never a missed reference (Acceptance notes).
- **(c) Stored references.** D8 has no `tool` row; S4's report (`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`) holds 0 `tool` rows. First-party tool records in `examples/`: 0 (the one `tools:` hit is `examples/app-showcase/scripts/mcp-fixture.mjs`, an MCP fixture's tool list).
- **(d) Built-in names.** `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` (`@objectstack/core`) holds `permission` and `email_template` only: tool census **0**. The platform-provided tool names live in the AI service's registry and are not refused here (step-0 ruling Q2 = A, 6760255704).

## Carried to repo:cloud

Once tool records stop being inert, or any cloud change first reads a package `tool` record: that reader **must** resolve a name from the referring item's own package (its own record, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure, ADR-0150 D3), **must** refuse a name two packages hold, naming every candidate, and must never take the first one registered, never reach a tool outside that closure, and never reach a tool only the environment holds. The same obligation is in `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` as a precondition of that change.

Also carried, separately from this PR: the cloud reading 6837767385 lists three cloud calls on the metadata service for type `tool` by bare name with no package (a fixed-name existence probe, and AI Studio's register and retract of its built-in tool mirror). They are outside this PR's caller count, which is this repo's. A bare removal of a name two packages hold is now refused `409`, so the mirror's retract can be refused where two namespaces each ship a tool named after a built-in; the refusal fails closed and picks no holder.

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: **new** `[#31985] one of two namespaces' tool holders disabled` (both orders): the served holder set is the enabled one, every-holder set is both, the bare read serves the enabled holder, a package with no namespace is still refused naming the disabled holder, a third namespace installs, and re-enabled the bare read refuses `409` naming both and not the disabled third. The switch pin reads main's full set with `tool` after `skill`.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts`: `tool` joins `UNBUNDLED` (the pin that lists the set's unbundled members).
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: `tool` joins main's `NAMESPACE_SCOPED` list.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: the sealed clash moves to a connector both namespaces declare.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the dist reached (`scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`) and restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight present, tree clean:

- **Predicate.** `tool` (and its comment) removed from `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `90a3b8c9` → `78392a64`), core rebuilt, marker absent from all 14 dist files: `vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t tool` → **9 failed**, 41 passed (the switch pin, the two-namespace install, the item seam, the cold boot, both co-owner pins, the `[#31985]` resolve pin and both orders of the new disabled-holder pin).
- **Store.** `tool` removed from `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `551ec5d4` → `9b9c30da`), metadata rebuilt, marker absent from all 56 dist files: objectql's "both kept" pin for `tool` **1 failed**; metadata's six slotted suites `-t tool` → **7 failed**. (A first attempt whose replacement was a substring of its anchor was refused by the tool before any run and restored; it measured nothing.)
- **Store, the HTTP layered doors (contract review S2, S5).** The same mutation, metadata rebuilt, marker absent from all 56 dist files, under `os-verify-lock`: `@objectstack/dogfood` `vitest run test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts -t "layers|already resolved by package"` → **9 passed** on HEAD and **9 passed** under the ablation (agent, skill, tool × the `/layers?package=` pin, the CONTROL bare read and bare layered read `409`, the D5 CONTROL). Restored to blob == HEAD, rebuilt, preflight present, tree clean. Read: the HTTP layered doors do not rest on the slotted store for a tool, so row 12 is unchanged and carried path (ii) is the in-process read's.

## Acceptance notes

- `NAMESPACE_UNIQUE_TYPES` (child N) still lists `tool`, so a tool's same-namespace co-owner is refused by N's sentence, not this rule's. That is today's answer, unchanged; the tool matrix's rival is therefore a package with no namespace.
- `findReferencesToMeta` for a tool name two namespaces hold lists both packages' referring skills (bare-name match). Over-inclusive is the safe direction for a "Used by" panel; the same holds today for `skill` targets. Not filed: no wrong answer that makes a delete unsafe.
- The fixture's sealed clash now rides on `connector`, the last covered type not narrowed besides `webhook` (#32577). The connector card (#31699 PR 3) moves it again, or leaves the section with no positive pin; noted for that card.
- **Carried, by registration order (red line 2).** (i) The boot hydration (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` → by-name `lookupArtifactItem`) grafts a stored package-less tool row of a two-holder name onto the first-registered holder's slot; reaching it takes a row an older release stored, then a second namespace's holder. #32692 keys that lookup by `(package, name)` for every type, as #32577 declares for a webhook. (ii) The protocol's in-process layered read (`getMetaItemLayered`, a bare name, no package) runs no two-holder judgement of its own; where the metadata service gives it no copy of the tool, it falls back to the registry's by-name artifact lookup and answers the first-registered holder. On both HTTP transports the layered door asks the plain bare read first (REST: `isItemOfDisabledPackage` → `getMetaItem` → `resolveItem`, step 1b of `createMetaLayeredAnswer`), which refuses two served holders `409` naming both. Measured on the artifact boot with `tool` taken back out of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (so the service keeps one copy and refuses nothing): the bare `GET /meta/tool/NAME/layers` still answers `409` naming both. So the pick is reachable by an in-process caller or a host with no door chain, not through the HTTP door. Not pinned here for a boot with no service copy. Neither path is code this change touches; a follow-up card for every narrowed type is the seat's.
- The cloud reading 6837767385 carries one note: where AI Studio mounts, the environment holds package-less `tool` rows named after the built-in tools (its mirror). What a package tool of one of those names answers beside that row is the existing one-side-without-a-package pairing, unchanged by this PR; it is not measured here.
- The platform-provided tool names are not built-ins here; if a later change makes package tool records reach the AI service's registry, that change owns the name clash with them.
